prompt: Cutoff opened first and hero is on the button with KTs. Which compact preflop action fits this transfer spot?
why_v1: The suited broadway hand is playable and hero has position, but the open in front changes the action from raising first to calling.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. KTs can continue in position after the cutoff opens, and calling respects the facing-open frame.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. Once the cutoff opens first, KTs on the button is a playable in-position continue, but the compact action is call instead of raising first.
